label: Rst gop-beta-cII system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a P4-like gop-beta-cII locus represented by DefenseFinder as the Rst_gop_beta_cll model and experimentally linked to lambda and P1 phage restriction.
observations: Rst gop-beta-cII branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual gop, beta, or cII genes, individual Gop, beta, or CII proteins, the DefenseFinder Rst_gop_beta_cll__gop, Rst_gop_beta_cll__beta, and Rst_gop_beta_cll__cll profiles, the Rst_gop_beta_cll source key, P4 satellites as mobile genetic elements, lambda or P1 resistance outside a complete gop-beta-cII locus, and other Rst or phage-defense systems.
